title: Quick Egyptian Cheese Curry
description: A floral, gooey brunch dish that blends panang paste and shio-koji with creamy Egyptian cheese for a satisfying, satvik-friendly breakfast.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Stir in minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add panang curry paste and cook, stirring, for 1 minute to release its flavors.
Pour in coconut milk and shio-koji, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add the cheese cubes and let them melt into the sauce, stirring until the mixture is gooey.
Squeeze in lemon juice and adjust seasoning with salt if needed.
Reduce heat to low and let the curry simmer for 3 minutes, allowing the flavors to blend.
Transfer the curry to a serving dish and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve immediately with warm pita or toast for a brunch-ready meal.
